name: Shoufuku Anju
source: A guest character from "[url=/v31432]Makimura Hazuki no Koigatari[/url]," she is [url=/c150926]Yukihisa[/url]'s aunt who manages a rundown apartment called "Shoufuku-sou." She can handle anything because she is the "Landlady." Despite her young appearance, she is almost fifty years old.
